title: Countries with taller average male height than the US

source.name: A century of trends in adult human height

notes: American men ranked 3rd tallest in the world in 1914 and fell to 37th by 2014 (out of ~200 countries/territories studied). Expressed here as the count of nations that out-height the US for clarity: 2 nations taller in 1914 (rank 3rd), 36 nations taller in 2014 (rank 37th) -- the same published ranking, restated as a count so a bigger bar means a bigger fall.
